findings.claim: Acceptance criterion 1.1 requires amending Goal 4, but the diff creates goals.md as a wholly new file, so the amendment is undemonstrable and this change silently authors all 13 goal bullets — including stack, removal-target, and exit-gate commitments — with no evidence in the packet that they match the operator-approved phase goals.
findings.evidence: Diff header `new file mode 100644` for goals.md; verification.md admits "Git renders the scoped `goals.md` input as a new file rather than a one-line amendment" and attests only to Goal 4's pre-edit ending (`assistant-ui + shadcn restyled Flat 2.0`). Nothing attests the provenance of the other 12 bullets. The plan excerpt cited in verification.md scopes C-01 to "Amend Goal 4 ... add the §6.1/§6.3 divergence", confirming the remaining bullets are out of scope yet ship in this diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Track the phase goals.md before C-01 (or commit a verbatim baseline first) so the diff shows the one-line Goal 4 amendment; alternatively record SHA-256 of the full pre-edit goals.md and reproduce the unchanged bullets as quoted evidence, as was done for the plan and decision log.

findings.claim: The file_tree already lists ./docs/ui-design-authority.md while the diff declares it `new file mode 100644`, and the same tree omits the openspec change directory and .refiner/ that the diff also creates — the packet's repository shape is internally inconsistent with the diff, undermining verification of what actually changed.
findings.evidence: file_tree entry `./docs/ui-design-authority.md` versus diff `--- /dev/null` / `+++ b/docs/ui-design-authority.md`; no `./openspec/changes/amend-goal4-base-ui-divergence` or `./.refiner` entries exist in the same tree.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate the file_tree from the same working-tree snapshot used to produce the diff, or annotate which entries are untracked.

findings.claim: The authority order's #1 source is "the active KBD phase decision log" — an untracked working-state file — so the very dependency problem this change fixed for D1 (unresolvable references to untracked control-plane files) is enshrined as the general rule for all future divergences.
findings.evidence: Authority order item 1: "Approved operator decisions in the active KBD phase decision log." The same page's D1 section notes the rationale had to be reproduced inline precisely because the page "does not depend on KBD working-state files being present in a packaged or committed documentation checkout," and refinement_log.md records Round 2 blocking on exactly this failure mode.
findings.suggested_fix: State that each operator decision's rationale and scope must be reproduced on this page at the time the decision is recorded, with the KBD path kept only as plaintext provenance — i.e., make the D1 remediation the documented procedure, not a one-off.

findings.claim: The refinement log records that the constraint sources it was supposed to apply were absent, so the "Constraints: PASS" verdict rests only on the change's own assertions rather than on any independent constraint document.
findings.evidence: "Source constraints: `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md` and PMPO refinement-state manifests were not present; applied the KBD execution contract, repository rules, D1, and the OpenSpec requirements" — the latter two are artifacts of the change under review itself, and the packet's `constraints` field is null.
findings.suggested_fix: Record explicitly that constraint validation was vacuous for this change, or restore/locate the constraints manifest before certifying future changes in this phase.
